title: Withdrawal above balance fails 403 'Insufficient account balance.' (C2441)

source.test: verify that withdrawal fails when balance is insufficient

scenario: Deposit 500, then attempt to withdraw 1000; the withdrawal must fail with HTTP 403 and a developer message containing 'Insufficient account balance.'.
grade: Refuse a withdrawal exceeding the available balance.
